Warm.name: Icy Stark Blue
Warm.reason: Cold blue tones clash with golden dermal pigments, creating a sallow or drained look.

Warm.name: Stark Optic White
Warm.reason: Pure fluorescent white can make warm skin appear overly yellow or washed out; opt for warm cream/ivory.

Warm.name: Cool Magenta / Fuchsia
Warm.reason: Blue-dominant bright magentas overwhelm warm complexions and emphasize facial shadows.

Warm.name: Cool Steel Grey
Warm.reason: Blue-leaning greys neutralize warm radiance and make skin appear fatigued.

Cool.name: Mustard Yellow / Ocher
Cool.reason: Heavy yellow-browns accentuate redness or make cool undertones appear dull.

Cool.name: Warm Orange / Rust
Cool.reason: Warm oranges fight directly with pink/blue skin undertones, causing a muddy complexion effect.

Cool.name: Warm Camel Tan
Cool.reason: Yellow-tinged beiges wash out cool skin; swap for crisp charcoal or midnight navy.

Cool.name: Olive Gold
Cool.reason: Dull yellow-green tones conflict with pink dermal undertones, draining vibrancy.

Neutral.name: Extreme Neon Yellow
Neutral.reason: Ultra-saturated acid neon tones overpower balanced neutral skin harmonies.

Neutral.name: Overly Acidic Lime
Neutral.reason: High-saturation electric lime greens pull focus away from facial features; choose soft sage instead.

Neutral.name: Harsh Fluo Orange
Neutral.reason: Uncalibrated hyper-warm neon hues disrupt the delicate equilibrium of neutral undertones.
